title: recommendation-service: elevated latency and errors
description: Customer support escalation: recommendation-service p95 latency reached 483ms (normally ~69ms) and error rate peaked at 28.3%.
root_cause_detail: An in-process cache in recommendation-service had no eviction policy or TTL and grew without bound.
expected_symptoms: recommendation-service memory_usage climbs gradually from ~53% to ~98% over ~39+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on recommendation-service
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~69ms to ~483ms as memory grows
recommendation-service errors appear late, error rate up to ~28.3%
recommendation-service db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
resolution: Restarted the pods to restore service and added a max size and TTL to the cache.
